summary: Iter106 — Master deployment readiness audit. Ran a focused 39-test backend suite (test_iter106_deployment_audit.py) covering health, multi-login + portal tokens, admin/HR/PM/FL portal scoping, _id leakage spot checks on 5 list endpoints, public submission endpoints, Time Off Request public-link end-to-end flow (HR auth required → public load → public submit → record persists → re-submit returns 410), PDF generation, CORS, and 422-not-500 validation. Frontend: sign-in flow works, Field Leadership Hub (/leadership) renders the 4 grouped sections (Daily Crew / Evaluations / Equipment Accountability / HR Actions) and Time Off tile is present. Zero console errors during /, /field, /leadership, /sign-in sweep. Control Every Detail. Protect Everything.' The /field page also contains 1 occurrence of 'masci hub' in body text. The spec explicitly states 'MASCI HUB should appear NOWHERE on user-facing surfaces — only the M-mark variant is acceptable'. RECOMMEND: NO-GO until Hub.jsx header logo + kicker are swapped to the M-mark variant. Everything else (auth scope isolation, _id hygiene, public POSTs, time-off end-to-end, PDF generation, console cleanliness) is GREEN.

critical_code_review_comments: conftest.py auto-injects X-Admin-Token on every requests call (via monkey-patch of requests.api.request and Session.request). This means ANY test that wants to verify auth-rejection MUST explicitly set headers={'X-Admin-Token': ''} or it will silently pass with admin credentials. Iter94 noted this; iter106 hit the same trap on test_fl_time_off_public_link_requires_auth and fixed it in-test. Recommend documenting this prominently in conftest.py docstring (already done) and adding a pytest marker like @pytest.mark.no_auto_admin to opt out cleanly.

Time-off public-link end-to-end works correctly: HR-issued token → public GET (no auth) → public POST submit (no auth) → record stored with kind=time_off_request → token marked used_at → re-submit correctly returns 410. PDF code path executes; preview env's AUTO_EMAIL_REPORTS=false correctly no-ops the Resend email build.

Zero MongoDB _id leakage across 5 list endpoints spot-checked (meetings, inspections, daily-reports, incidents, equipment-inspections). Existing Pydantic response_model + explicit {'_id': 0} projections are doing their job.

Public POST endpoints (/api/inspections, /api/meetings, /api/incidents, /api/daily-reports, /api/equipment-inspections, /api/qaqc-inspections) all accept minimal payloads (200/201) AND return 422 (not 500) on malformed input. Rate limiting is off in preview (RATE_LIMITING=off env) but the code path exists.

HR portal scope isolation: /api/hr/* routes correctly reject bare X-Admin-Token (no X-HR-Token) — confirmed across all 4 HR endpoints (field-leadership, time-verification, training-records, employee-accountability).
